name: Hasshub
overview: Hasshub was a male biblical figure known for his role in the restoration efforts in Jerusalem. He is specifically noted for repairing a section of the wall and the Tower of Furnaces. His tribal affiliation is not recorded, and there are no additional notes about his life or activities beyond his construction work.
namesAndTitles: The name Hasshub is a proper name meaning 'considerate.' This meaning is derived from the Hebrew context and is not indicated as being given directly by God. The name appears in Nehemiah 3:11.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Hasshub as the son of Pahath-moab, establishing a direct paternal relationship. No other family relationships are recorded beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Hasshub's significance lies in his contribution to the physical rebuilding of Jerusalem's defenses during the post-exilic period. By repairing a section of the wall and the Tower of Furnaces, he played a part in the community's efforts to restore security and order under God's providence. His work, recorded in Nehemiah 3:11, highlights the collective responsibility of God's people in reestablishing their city and faith.
